keen_eye.name: Keen Eye
keen_eye.description: +5% Fire Potion critical chance per level.

treasure_hunter.name: Treasure Hunter
treasure_hunter.description: +2 crystals per battle won, per level.

field_satchel.name: Field Satchel
field_satchel.description: Begin normal expeditions with one deterministic starter relic.

scout_lens.name: Scout Lens
scout_lens.description: Reachable battle routes reveal their alchemical hazard family, never the enemy.

formula_primer.name: Formula Primer
formula_primer.description: Each battle begins with one Wild essence recorded in the Reaction Chamber.

emergency_cork.name: Emergency Cork
emergency_cork.description: The first two normal New Mix uses each run cost no Mana; both still spend a move.

wayfinder_seal.name: Wayfinder Seal
wayfinder_seal.description: Adds one extra legal route from the starting chamber when the map permits.
